name: Constantine
description: Proprietor of The Sylph's Embrace on the Pearl -- shrewd, protective of her workers, fiercely independent. Operates under Marisette's authority. After Santo's attack on Emmeralda in her house, she is hiring protection and wants justice.
narrative: Constantine runs The Sylph's Embrace, a high-end pleasure house on the Pearl, under the overall authority of the madame Marisette. Sharp, businesslike and fiercely protective of her workers, she prizes loyalty and codes of conduct. Her establishment was the scene of Santo di Teufel's brutal ritual attack on the courtesan Emmeralda, and in the aftermath she is quietly hiring protection and seeking anyone who can deliver justice. No warrior, but no fool either: she keeps a stiletto and a loaded hand crossbow close, and reads a room well.

extras.role: Proprietor of The Sylph's Embrace, the high-end pleasure house on the Pearl. Protective of her workers, fiercely independent, operates under [[marisette]]'s overall authority.

actor_notes:
Constantine
BODY: On her feet the entire time you are in her house. Sleeves shoved past the elbow because she has been working. Stands in her own doorways and does not move aside until she has decided about you.
BUSINESS: A ledger open, linen to be counted, a girl to be sent somewhere. She carries on with it while you talk. When she stops, the scene has changed and the whole room feels it.
LISTENS: Does not fill silence. Lets you finish, then waits two beats longer, which is how she gets the true version out of people.
WANTS: To find out what you are going to cost her before she lets you further in.
GUARDS: That she nearly took Santo's money. Rather than admit it she becomes exact about what she actually said.
BREAKS: The hands stop. Both palms flat on the table, and she does not look up.
KEY: "I have buried four girls out of this house. I did the books for every one of them."
